name: Future Fast Food
overview: Future Fast Food by Mythical Kitchen is a YouTube series where chefs recreate and reimagine futuristic, over-the-top, or discontinued fast-food concepts, blending culinary creativity with social trends and tech speculation, featuring outlandish creations like a Ramen Big Mac or a KFC Waffle House mashup, exploring how AI, sustainability, and new food science might alter our future menus.
